title: Nat call deck, Fri 2 Oct
source: ops/handoffs/2026-10-02-call-desk-cleanup.md (re-ranked from 2026-09-28 deck: oldest last contact first) · JEM 2 Oct: also dropped Bird in Hand (hold), Goldstone (hard hold), Lower Bourne (Wait); Sun 29 Nov removed (CL booking)
rules: Check both calendars before offering any date.
Never restate a fee already agreed.

venues.quote: No fee sent. Natalie moved the price conversation to the phone.
venues.lastMsg: Jaela loves Jake's sound and is definitely open to booking. She is busy with events for about 2 months and asked for rates, set lengths and a contact number.
venues.why: She asked for a call and for prices, and her busy spell ends around early November.
venues.note: Last contact: 09 Sep (Us) · The +44 7523 924644 in haggle-muddy-duck is Natalie's number that we gave Jaela, not Jaela's.

venues.lastMsg: She loved it, would put it to the committee and asked for Saturdays.
venues.why: The committee met on 7 Sep, so call for the verdict; Sat 7 Nov is the only free 2026 Saturday.

venues.quote: 4 Sep: £250 for a 2h show or £375 for 3h, Sunday afternoon, with the Oct-Dec free Sundays listed. Chased 11 Sep.
venues.lastMsg: She hadn't forgotten; she was busy and away and would get back "next week".
venues.why: She asked for a Sunday afternoon, and Sundays are what Jake has free in 2026 (a Christmas Sunday on 6, 20 or 27 Dec is an easy yes). She is now about 10 days past her own "next week". Local.

venues.lastMsg: "Thank you, I will let you know"
venues.why: Local pub; a call can offer dates and a price.

venues.quote: 10 Sep: £275 for 2×1h or £375 for 3×45 (£250/£350 if they book 4). Then on 14 Sep: £250 for Thu 22 Oct, 7-9pm (2×1h), with a nudge on 17 Sep.
venues.lastMsg: Holly asked the price for a Thursday 7-9pm and whether Jake is free on Thu 22 Oct.
venues.daysNote: since last contact · Jake phoned on Fri 18 Sep and Holly was due to confirm on Mon 21 Sep. Nothing has come in since.
venues.why: She named the date herself, the price is in line with what she asked, and the gig is 3½ weeks away. One call gets a yes or no on 22 Oct. (Board rule: no email chase, so phone is the agreed route. Confirm 22 Oct is still clear.)

venues.quote: 10 Sep: £250 cash or £280 on the books for 2×1h (8-11). Sharon accepted £250 cash and asked for 28 Aug (2027), which Jake can't do. Other August weekends were offered, and we chased on 17 Sep.
venues.lastMsg: "I will get back to you, just need to juggle some things around."
venues.why: The price is agreed and only the date is open. This is 2027 money. Do not restate the fee (NEVER_AGAIN #25).
venues.note: Last contact: 17 Sep (Us) · Fee already agreed. Do not restate the fee on the call.

venues.quote: 14 Sep: £285 for 2×1h or £385 for 3×45, Sat/Sun (£250/£350 if they book several). Chased 21 Sep.
venues.lastMsg: Thanks for the information, "we will be in touch".
venues.why: The GM has engaged twice. Offer a Sunday in Nov or Dec. The board says no second email chase, so the phone is the only nudge left.

venues.quote: On 17 Sep they offered £250 for Sat 3×45, 9pm-12am, paid by bank transfer on invoice. We countered the same day: £250 cash or £275 on the books for 2×1h, and £350 cash or £375 on the books for 3 sets.
venues.lastMsg: They always want new acts for Saturday nights in the Members Bar and pay £250 for 3×45 by bank transfer.
venues.why: They have already named a budget and a slot, so only the format and fee gap is left. A call can settle a number (for example 2×1h at £275 on invoice) and fix Sat 7 Nov or a 2027 Saturday. Give the chase 24-48h first.

venues.quote: 18 Sep: £300 cash or £330 on the books for Sunday 4.30-6.30 (2×1h). We also asked for her budget.
venues.lastMsg: Claire asked what Jake charges for 2 hours on a Sunday, saying they are a small members club that watches its budget.
venues.why: Her Sunday slot fits the free 2026 Sundays. We already asked her budget, so a call gets her number and a date.

venues.quote: 17 Sep: £300 cash for 2×1h as a one-off, or £250 a night if they book 4. Saturday evening or Sunday afternoon.
venues.lastMsg: Terry asked the price for Saturday 8.30-9.30 and 10-11, and for Sunday 4-5 and 5.30-6.30.
venues.why: He gave exact set times for both days, and Sundays are free in 2026. A call finds out whether £300 versus £250×4 is the sticking point. Ask for Terry.
venues.note: Last contact: 28 Sep (Us) · Club line. Terry's own number is not in the files.

venues.quote: £325 cash for Sunday 2×1h or £450 for 3×1h (16 Sep).
venues.lastMsg: Will review free Sundays next year and wants one Sunday only.
venues.why: They intend to book one, so a call gets the 2027 date.

venues.quote: £400 for one Sat of 3 sets, or £350 each for 4 (16 Sep).
venues.lastMsg: Julie asked the fee for Sat 8.30-11.30, 3 sets.
venues.why: Test her budget; 10 Oct in that quote is now taken.

venues.quote: £300 cash (£330 on the books) for 2h or £450 for 3h, Sat/Sun (15 Sep).
venues.why: Silent since the quote and FAR; a call checks whether the fee is the problem.

venues.quote: £250 cash for Sat 2×1h or £300 for 3×1h, with May-Jul 2027 Saturdays (21 Sep).
